scope: Static source/math classification of supplied TANGENT records and faces. Axis 1 is glTF 2.0 §3.7.2.1 record validity plus frame degeneracy; axis 2 is the raw exported-UV derivative metric. No engine, no artifact change, no promotion, no acceptance.

categoryDefinitions.specInvalid: nonfinite, zero/non-unit T, w not in {-1,+1}, non-unit N, or cross(N,T)*w degenerate
categoryDefinitions.specValidDerivativeDisagreeing: spec-valid and used by a full-rank face whose stored w/dP-du/dP-dv comparison disagrees
categoryDefinitions.unaffectedOther: spec-valid with no raw derivative disagreement; UV-rank/zero-area/no-incident-face records are sub-reasons, not verdicts

stricterReadingIncludingUVRank.definition: category (a) plus category (c) records whose only full-rank-equivalent path is a UV-rank failure
